title: 江城子·乙卯正月二十日夜记梦
titlePy: Jiāng Chéng Zǐ · Yǐ Mǎo Zhēng Yuè Èr Shí Rì Yè Jì Mèng
titleEn: To the Tune “River Town”: A Dream on the Night of the 20th Day of the First Month, 1075
author: 苏轼
intro: Ten years after his young wife died, Su Shi dreams that he is home and sees her at the window doing her hair. Neither can speak; they only cry. One of the most moving poems of grief in Chinese.
analysis: 苏轼的第一位妻子王弗十六岁嫁给他，二十七岁就去世了，葬在四川眉山老家。十年后，苏轼在山东密州做官，一天夜里梦见了她，醒来写下这首词，这是中国最早、也最有名的悼亡词（怀念去世妻子的词）之一。开头“十年生死两茫茫”，一个活着、一个死了，彼此什么都不知道；“不思量，自难忘”，不刻意去想，却怎么也忘不了。她的坟在千里之外，想说说心里的凄凉都没有地方说。就算真的见面，她恐怕也认不出满脸风尘、头发像霜一样白的我了。下阕写梦：忽然回到家乡，她正坐在小窗前梳妆，和从前一样。两人互相看着，说不出话，只有泪流不止。最后想到：那个月光下长着小松树的山冈，就是年年让我伤心的地方。全词语言朴素，没有华丽的词，感情却真挚得让人心痛。
analysisEn: Su Shi’s first wife, Wang Fu, married him at sixteen and died at twenty-six (twenty-seven by the Chinese count), and was buried in his home town in Sichuan. Ten years later, serving as an official in Mizhou in Shandong, he dreamed of her one night and wrote this when he woke. It is one of the earliest and best-loved poems in Chinese written in mourning for a wife. The first line sets the distance: ten years, one living and one dead, each knowing nothing of the other. “I don’t try to think of you, yet I can’t forget.” Her grave is a thousand miles away, so there is nowhere to tell her how desolate he feels — and even if they met, she might not know him now, his face covered in dust, his hair white as frost. Then the dream: he is suddenly home, and there she is at the little window, doing her hair as she used to. They look at each other without a word, and only tears come. The ending returns to the waking world: every year his heart will break at that hillside of short pines under the moon, where she lies. There are no fancy words here at all. The plainness is what makes it hurt.
background: Su Shi (1037–1101) married Wang Fu in 1054; she died in 1065 and was buried at Meishan, Sichuan. He wrote this in 1075 (the yimao year), while serving as prefect of Mizhou in Shandong, exactly ten years after her death.
pronunciation: 不思量：量 读 liáng（词中押 ang 韵；现代口语“思量”读 sī liang）。泪千行：行 háng，不读 xíng。忽还乡：还 huán。纵使相逢应不识：应 yīng。料得 liào dé。肠断 cháng duàn。鬓 bìn。轩窗 xuān。
version: 采用中学语文通行版本。异文：“惟有泪千行”一作“唯有泪千行”；“料得年年肠断处”一作“料得年年断肠处”。全词上下两阕，网站按句读分为十行。

lines.py: shí nián shēng sǐ liǎng máng máng
lines.lit: Ten years, living and dead, both vast and blurred;
lines.en: Ten years — you dead, I living — and each of us lost to the other.

lines.py: bù sī liáng, zì nán wàng
lines.lit: I don’t think of you, yet by myself it is hard to forget.
lines.en: I do not try to think of you, and still I cannot forget.

lines.py: qiān lǐ gū fén, wú chù huà qī liáng
lines.lit: A lonely grave a thousand li away; nowhere to speak of my desolation.
lines.en: Your lonely grave is a thousand miles away; there is no one I can tell my sorrow to.

lines.py: zòng shǐ xiāng féng yīng bù shí
lines.lit: Even if we met, you would surely not recognize me:
lines.en: Even if we met, you would not know me now —

lines.py: chén mǎn miàn, bìn rú shuāng
lines.lit: dust all over my face, temples like frost.
lines.en: my face covered in dust, my hair white as frost.

lines.py: yè lái yōu mèng hū huán xiāng
lines.lit: Tonight in a dim dream I suddenly returned home;
lines.en: Last night, in a faint dream, I was suddenly home again;

lines.py: xiǎo xuān chuāng, zhèng shū zhuāng
lines.lit: By the small window, you were just combing your hair and making up.
lines.en: you sat at the little window, doing your hair.

lines.py: xiāng gù wú yán, wéi yǒu lèi qiān háng
lines.lit: We looked at each other without words; there were only tears in a thousand lines.
lines.en: We looked at each other and said nothing, only cried and cried.

lines.py: liào dé nián nián cháng duàn chù
lines.lit: I expect the place where year after year my heart breaks
lines.en: I know where my heart will break, year after year:

lines.py: míng yuè yè, duǎn sōng gāng
lines.lit: is the bright-moon night, the ridge of short pines.
lines.en: a moonlit night, the hill of little pines.

words.note: 现代汉语“白茫茫”“前途茫茫”。

words.en: to think about; to dwell on
words.note: 现代口语读 sīliang，意思是考虑。
古代可作动词，今天“话家常”“话别”还保留。
现代汉语书面语仍用，如“萍水相逢”。
现代汉语说“认识”“认出来”。

words.en: to do one’s hair and make-up
words.note: 现代汉语仍用，如“梳妆台”。
现代汉语多说“肝肠寸断”“断肠”。
现代汉语多写“山冈”“山岗”。

imagery.name: 霜
imagery.zh: “鬓如霜”写十年奔波让人老了，头发都白了。
imagery.en: “Temples like frost”: ten years of hardship have turned his hair white.

imagery.name: 月
imagery.zh: 明月夜的山冈，是亡妻长眠的地方，月光照着孤坟，格外凄清。
imagery.en: Moonlight falls on the hill where his wife lies buried — the loneliest image in the poem.

imagery.name: 松
imagery.zh: 坟边种的小松树，是古人守护坟墓的习惯，也象征思念长久不变。
imagery.en: Short pines were planted beside graves in old China; here they also stand for a love that does not fade.
